about_the_game:
Pasture Palette is a living art piece where your field becomes the canvas.

Instead of planting rows for harvest, you shape colors across the land. Imbue objects and flowers with new hues, guide sheep into vibrant coats, and slowly layer your pasture into something playful and expressive.

Your dogs keep the farm running while you create. They collect wool, spin it into clothing, and trade for items that expand your options. With every step, you discover more hidden within your flock and unlock new ways to express your creativity through the pasture.

It’s about gentle progress, experimenting with color, and watching your farm grow into a painting that feels alive.

Imbue colors - Paint objects and flowers to shape the look of your pasture. 

Unique sheep variants - Discover quirky sheep with coats in surprising shades and textures.

Doggos! - Companions turn wool into goods and provide you with the funds to keep painting. 

Expand your pasture - Increase the size of your field to host even more sheep.

Grow your flock - Collect and raise a wide variety of colorful sheep.

A living art piece - Your pasture evolves into something vibrant, personal, and ever-changing.
